title: Goa RTI Online portal
issuer: Department of Information and Publicity, Government of Goa
provision: Portal scope, filing stages and payment gateway
excerpt: The portal supports applications and first and second appeals for listed Goa State Government public authorities, with Internet banking, cards and UPI through e-Challan.
notes: Current page reports an update date of 14 August 2026. Second-appeal drafting remains outside v1 scope despite portal availability.

technical.notes: Current public portal scope and filing stages inspected.
